title: OSTF Audio Model Profile 1.0.0

id.description: Stable identity of this logical Audio Model profile; its individual snapshot records follow immutable ID rules.

profileVersion.description: Audio Model Profile version, embedded in Production Session 0.5.0.

sources.description: Immutable bindings to existing Production audioSource assets.

objects.description: Acoustic objects and observations, independently addressable.

decompositions.description: Coherent component groups and residual accounting.

renders.description: Pinned rendered outputs and exact saved-region bindings.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

description: Optional native acoustic analysis/edit interchange layer. Ordinary Production audioRegions remain saved playback authority.

version.description: Exact processor version; display names alone are insufficient.

modelId.description: Model identifier when a learned or parameterized model is used.

modelSha256.description: Digest of the exact model bytes, when available.

configurationSha256.description: Digest of the exact configuration asset bytes; not a digest of arbitrary reserialized JSON.

configurationAssetId.description: Existing Production asset containing processing settings.

seed.description: Recorded random seed; a seed alone does not guarantee cross-engine determinism.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Engine.description: Processor identity and reproducibility metadata. No processor is mandated by this profile.

startFrame.description: First decoded sample frame, inclusive; shared across channels.

channels.description: Selected source channels; absent means all channels.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

SourceRange.description: A bounded range in immutable original/derived source frames.

id.description: Stable source ID; changes to decoded content require a new ID.

assetId.description: Existing Production audioSource asset; its sampling metadata defines this source.

assetSha256.description: Pinned exact asset bytes; MUST equal the referenced Production asset digest.

role.description: Provenance role, never a playback instruction.

decoding.description: PCM containers use their decoded PCM sample order; other codecs require a decoder identity.

decoder.description: Required for specified-decoder; identifies the same complete decoded stream described by existing Production asset metadata. No cropping or redefinition of asset.frameCount.

originalAssetId.description: Retained original bytes when this source is a canonical decoded or derived asset.

items.description: Channel label, for example mono, left or right.

channelLabels.description: Ordered labels; length equals Production asset audioChannels.

derivedFromSourceIds.description: Source lineage; no inferred processing algorithm.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Source.description: Immutable source binding. Asset bytes and complete decoded-stream sampling metadata remain in Production assets.

originalSourceId.description: Original source used to create the proxy.

originalOffsetFrames.description: Original-frame position corresponding to proxy frame zero.

originalFramesPerProxyFrame.description: Exact affine slope from proxy frames to original frames.

channelMatrix.description: Rows are proxy channels; columns are original channels.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

AnalysisProxy.description: Recorded affine resampling/downmix map. Non-affine preprocessing requires a declared opaque extension and cannot claim this mapping is exact.

status.description: Completion state; complete does not claim correctness.

supersedesAnalysisIds.description: Prior snapshots superseded for this interpretation, retained for lineage.

notes.description: Human-readable scope, limitations or diagnostics; never machine instructions.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Analysis.description: Analysis observations are immutable and never silently overwritten by user edits.

groupId.description: Alternative group within that analysis; at most one selected member per group.

selected.description: Authored selection only; selecting does not render or replace Core notes.

confidence.description: Interpretation score with declared method, not universally calibrated probability.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Hypothesis.description: Alternative coherent interpretation; unselected hypotheses remain preservable.

centerHz.description: Estimated fundamental or perceived pitch in Hz.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

PitchEstimate.description: Pitch observation. Absence is valid for unpitched, unresolved or unvoiced objects.

label.description: Estimated instrument or source label; not a historical track identity.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Attribution.description: Instrument attribution may be uncertain or absent.

kind.description: Semantic category; overlapping ranges are permitted.

sourceRange.description: Location of evidence in an input source, not necessarily isolated audio.

isolation.description: Detected note pitches do not imply separated waveform availability.

analysisId.description: Analysis snapshot from which the object was derived.

musicalObjectId.description: Optional link to current Score musicalModel.objects.

relatedEntities.description: Explicit many-to-many representation links; do not imply edit propagation.

parentObjectIds.description: Structural parents, including mixtures; graph is acyclic.

supersedesObjectIds.description: Earlier objects replaced/split/merged by this new immutable interpretation.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Object.description: An audio contribution or observation, not necessarily an independently recoverable signal.

frame.description: Absolute frame in curve.sourceId before edits.

value.description: Numeric value in declared unit; null explicitly marks an unknown/unvoiced interval boundary.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

CurvePoint.description: Curve point. Points are strictly increasing in frame.

sourceId.description: Source coordinate space shared by all curve points.

unit.description: Declared public scalar unit; Hz values are positive and gains/ratios nonnegative.

interpolation.description: Interpolation within two consecutive non-null points.

outside.description: Behavior before first/after last point; null endpoints remain undefined.

points.description: Ordered observations or target values; no interpolation across a null endpoint.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Curve.description: Source-frame scalar trajectory; frequency and offsets are never inferred from unlabelled numbers.

sourceId.description: Source signal to which the mask transform applies.

startFrame.description: Source frame at the declared transform origin.

hopFrames.description: Distance between transform-frame origins in source frames.

windowPeriodic.description: For hann/hamming, true uses denominator N and false N-1.

windowAssetId.description: Window coefficients asset for window=asset; float64le, fftSize entries.

normalization.description: Raw-sum DFT scaling: unitary=1/sqrt(N) both directions; forward=1/N forward and 1 inverse; inverse=1 forward and 1/N inverse.

centering.description: Transform origin at left sample or center; centered uses floor(N/2) left extension.

padding.description: Boundary extension; reflect excludes the edge sample; none omits incomplete windows.

axisOrder.description: Row-major tensor; frequency index varies fastest.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Stft.description: Public STFT-mask descriptor. Coefficients are amplitudes in [0,1]; phase comes from the identified source transform.

objectId.description: Acoustic object represented; source may be a derived isolated asset.

kind.description: Public representations or versioned opaque payload.

waveform.description: Actual decoded waveform range; only present for waveform.

assetId.description: Production data asset for stft-mask or opaque representation.

mediaType.description: Payload media type, required for opaque.

formatId.description: Namespaced representation format identifier, required for opaque.

engine.description: Model identity needed to interpret model-specific payloads.

requirements.description: Actions and features required to interpret/edit/render this representation.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Representation.description: Parallel audio descriptions. An opaque latent is not a portable waveform.

representationId.description: Waveform representation of the contribution on its source grid.

role.description: Residual is bound to this exact decomposition, not discarded noise.

gainLinear.description: Linear amplitude multiplier, applied before channel mixing; may be negative.

delayFrames.description: Integer delay at input sample rate, before placement at decomposition input start; negative is advance.

channelMatrix.description: Rows are input-mixture channels; columns are component waveform channels. Absent requires equal channel counts and identity mapping.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Component.description: Explicit contribution to a linear reconstruction or documented nonlinear input.

domain.description: Each integer PCM source is scaled by 2^(bits-1); floating PCM retains numerical amplitude.

maxAbsoluteError.description: Producer-asserted maximum absolute channel-sample error after stated alignment.

comparedFrames.description: Frame count over which the comparison was made.

method.description: Producer method description including decode, arithmetic and clipping policies.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

ReconstructionEvidence.description: A producer assertion, not certification by a schema validator or this specification release.

input.description: Mixture range whose decomposition is described.

components.description: Contributions; at most one residual entry.

mixing.description: Only linear-sum has a native numerical summation contract.

processAssetId.description: Opaque process graph/recipe for nonlinear-process; not executed on load.

reconstruction.description: Degree asserted by producer; sample-consistent requires numerical evidence and linear-sum.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Decomposition.description: Decomposition and residual binding; does not identify historic multitrack recordings.

sourceFrame.description: Absolute original frame in target object source range.

outputOffsetFrame.description: Frame offset from output object start, at the target source sample rate.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

WarpAnchor.description: Strictly increasing monotonic anchor pair; endpoints cover entire target object range.

id.description: Operation ID scoped to its immutable edit plan.

targetObjectId.description: Single acoustic object target; several targets use separate operations.

coordinateSpace.description: All curves and anchors refer to original object evidence frames, transported through earlier warps.

cents.description: Relative pitch/formant shift in cents; 1200 cents is frequency factor 2.

gainDb.description: Amplitude change in dB; amplitude multiplier is 10^(gainDb/20).

curveRepresentationId.description: Curve representation: pitch-curve permits hertz or cents-offset; gain-curve requires decibels.

pitchIntent.description: Optional editorial meaning; resolved curve remains authoritative.

anchors.description: Piecewise-linear monotonic frame map. First output offset is zero; source endpoints equal target range endpoints.

pitchPolicy.description: Time-warp pitch intent; DSP output equality is not standardized.

maskRepresentationId.description: stft-mask representation whose source and extent match target.

replacementRepresentationId.description: Waveform representation replacing target audio; generated/recorded provenance remains on its object/source.

feature.description: Namespaced feature identifier required for engine-operation.

parametersAssetId.description: Opaque operation parameters/recipe in Production assets.

engine.description: Processor intended for engine-operation; missing runtime uses fallback or unsupported state.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Operation.description: Ordered frozen edit intent. Parsing does not execute processing.

id.description: Immutable edit-plan revision ID; any operation or binding change requires new ID.

inputSourceIds.description: Original/derived sources the plan depends on.

analysisIds.description: Analysis snapshots used for object identity and interpretation.

hypothesisIds.description: Chosen coherent hypotheses; other alternatives must not be implicitly summed.

operations.description: Ordered operations; source coordinate anchors are stable across previous transforms.

state.description: Unresolved plans are preserved but not automatically rendered.

unresolvedObjectIds.description: Targets whose reanalysis mapping could not be resolved.

supersedesPlanIds.description: Prior edit plans retained for non-destructive history.

requirements.description: Explicit required processing features and fallback behavior.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

EditPlan.description: Immutable ordered edit transaction, separate from analysis and saved Production playback.

assetSha256.description: Digest equal to both source binding and Production asset.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

InputBinding.description: Pinned source input to a render.

assetId.description: Existing Production non-audio payload dependency, such as a mask or processor configuration.

assetSha256.description: Digest of the exact payload bytes; MUST equal Production asset.sha256.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

DataBinding.description: Pinned non-waveform dependency of an analysis/edit/render recipe.

scoreSha256.description: Exact raw UTF-8 bound Score bytes; changed Score invalidates freshness until explicit rebind/re-render.

inputs.description: Every waveform source dependency of the edit plan, including supplied replacement sources. Non-waveform dependencies use dataInputs.

dataInputs.description: All non-waveform dependencies of referenced representations, operations and processor configuration.

mode.description: Complete replacement signal or difference signal; never inferred from a file name.

stage.description: Output enters Production channel insert chain once; no implicit wet/dry duplication.

coveredAudioRegionIds.description: Authored input regions covered by this render.

outputAudioRegionIds.description: Materialized ordinary Production audioRegions; their existing mute/comp state is playback authority.

determinism.description: Producer assertion. Stored output digest defines exact interchange, not another renderer.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

Render.description: Scoped cached render. Adding this metadata never starts playback or changes region mute flags.

feature.description: Feature identifier from Audio Model feature registry or a namespace-qualified extension.

actions.description: Claims are per action, not a single aggregate capability level.

materialDomains.description: Domains for which support is claimed.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data; preserve unknown values without executing them.

ProcessorFeature.description: Self-declared capability; not a quality or certification guarantee.
